messages:
maya: Quick sync — freeze window tomorrow 11:00 PDT for the devex release. Need final owners for SDK, docs, sample apps, quickstarts, and changelog cutoffs. Who can own the final sign-off? Calling out potential blockers: sampleapp CI flakes, docs missing streaming example, SDK packaging regression. @chris @devon pls confirm.

chris: I can own SDK packaging sign-off. Will run final smoke: `npm pack && pip wheel .` by 10:30. Found a regression in wheel metadata, fixing rn (PR incoming).

devon: I'll take sample apps + quickstarts. I'm hitting a flaky integration test in sampleapp-e2e — suspect a network race in CI. @sre-bot can you confirm if any network changes on staging runners in the last 24h?

sre-bot: No network rule changes detected in staging. Kernel patch rolled at 1923456650 but that shouldn't affect egress. Happy to re-run the job on request.

ari: Docs side — I need a final API streaming example for the SDK (server + client snippet). @jen can you review the example by 09:30? Also need a short changelog stub from product for the embedding tweak.

jen: On it. Product DM'd the embed blurb earlier, will paste into the changelog PR before 08:45.

sam: FYI legal flagged a telemetry line in quickstarts that references an internal Sentry DSN. I'll scrub before merge.

devon: Requesting a quick canary deploy of the sampleapps branch to staging so I can validate the fix. Can we get a short window ~09:00-09:20?

chris: SDK smoke done locally. Packaging fix in PR #468. Can someone kick the release workflow once Ari merges docs?

maya: Plan: freeze at 11:00 PDT. Critical-path owners: SDK — chris; Sampleapps/quickstarts — devon; Docs/changelog — ari+jen; Telemetry scrub — sam. If you can't meet sign-off, ping now. Add a short checklist comment in your PRs. :thumbsup: 

devon: CI rerun requested. @sre-bot please requeue sampleapp-e2e-1923.

sre-bot: Requeued job sampleapp-e2e-1923. Estimated start in ~3m.

devon: Test passed on rerun. Deploy window OK for 09:05. I'll trigger canary.

ari: Docs PR open: r? @jen for streaming examples. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/docs/pull/274

jen: Reviewed, left minor nits, lgtm after fix. I'll merge at 08:50.

chris: PR #468 merged. Build artifacts pushed to staging bucket.

maya: Great. Last ask — if you change any semver or public API behavior, call it out in the changelog summary (1-2 bullets). We stop edits after freeze except emergency patches.

sam: Telemetry scrub done, pushed commit to quickstarts. PR 299.

devon: Canary deployed. Manual smoke looks good. I'll open a follow-up issue for the flaky test with logs.

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll run the release checklist at 10:50 and announce the freeze. If any blockers pop up, reopen this thread.
